# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: FE-026 Courses & Materials Rework

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage of UX/UI requirements for the Courses and Materials screens rework (Figma frames 02.1–02.7).  
**Created**: 2026-11-15  
**Feature**: [specs/001-fe026-courses-materials/spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Figma Traceability & Layout Hierarchy

- [ ] CHK001 Are canonical Figma frame node IDs explicitly specified for all seven screens/dialogs (02.1 through 02.7) on Page `08 · EduBranch – Bản hoàn chỉnh`? [Traceability, Spec §3.2]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the desktop canvas target viewport quantified as 1440px across all primary view specifications? [Clarity, Spec §3.2, Spec §9]
- [ ] CHK003 Are layout hierarchy and column proportions defined for the 2-column layout on Frame 02.1 (left card list vs. right detail overview panel)? [Completeness, Spec §3.2, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 Are aspect ratio, thumbnail dimensions, and fallback visual treatments specified for course card cover images? [Completeness, Spec §3.2, Frame 02.1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the FAILED material action button label conflict (Figma node `586:8570` "Thử lại" [C2-A] vs PO Q3 "Tải lên lại" [C2-B]: `BLOCKED-ON-C2 — pending PO`) documented neutrally with exact facts and PO citation? [Consistency, Spec §3.2.1, PO Q3, C2]
- [ ] CHK006 Are visual geometry and overlay specifications defined for modal dialogs (radius 18px, full viewport scrim, no backdrop blur)? [Completeness, Spec §3.2, R01 §4.3]

## 2. Component States Completeness (States Matrix Coverage)

- [ ] CHK007 Are loading state representations (skeleton cards, skeleton table rows) explicitly specified for asynchronous course and material data fetching? [Completeness, Spec §5]
- [ ] CHK008 Are zero-data Empty State requirements (icon tile, title, helper description, primary CTA button) defined for courses when none exist? [Completeness, Spec §5, Frame 02.1]
- [ ] CHK009 Are zero-data Empty State requirements defined for courses with zero uploaded materials, including drag-and-drop prompt guidance? [Completeness, Spec §5, Frame 02.4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the fallback state for the RAG Source Inspector (02.7) specified with honest empty/info messaging when the backend chunks API is unavailable? [Clarity, Spec §4.3, Spec §5, PO Q2]
- [ ] CHK011 Are visual token specifications defined for all four material processing states (`PENDING`, `PROCESSING`, `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`) including background, text, and icon tokens? [Completeness, Spec §3.3, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the background polling feedback requirement (3-second cadence, non-blocking refresh, no layout shift) clearly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §4.2, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Are in-flight submission states (disabled controls, button loading indicator) documented for course creation/edit and material upload modals? [Completeness, Spec §5, Frame 02.2, Frame 02.5]
- [ ] CHK014 Are success feedback requirements (toast confirmation, auto-closing dialogs, list re-synchronization) specified for create, edit, course removal (BLOCKED-ON-C1: C1-A vs C1-B), and material delete flows? [Completeness, Spec §5]

## 3. Roles, Permissions & Ownership Boundaries

- [ ] CHK015 Is the user role boundary (`LECTURER` role mandatory) explicitly specified for all course and material management routes? [Completeness, Spec §1.2, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the course ownership invariant (`currentUser.id === lecturer_id`) documented for all course inspection, modification, and removal (BLOCKED-ON-C1: C1-A vs C1-B) actions? [Consistency, Spec §1.3, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK017 Are interface requirements specified for handling HTTP 403 Forbidden responses when a lecturer attempts to access an unowned course or material? [Coverage, Spec §1.2, Spec §5]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the student isolation requirement (immediate redirection to student desk or 403 page upon attempting to navigate to lecturer routes) documented? [Coverage, Spec §1.2]
- [ ] CHK019 Are architectural boundaries documented to prohibit direct browser communication with the internal FastAPI AI Service (`/internal/v1/*`)? [Boundary, Spec §1.3, FND §3]

## 4. Localization (i18n) & Academic Terminology Standards

- [ ] CHK020 Does every heading, label, column, helper and dialog render fully in the selected language (Vietnamese default, English via the switch), no mixed language? [Completeness, Spec §3.3, Spec §FR-012, Jira AC 3]
- [ ] CHK021 Are canonical higher-education domain terms (`Khóa học`, `Tài liệu môn học`, `Giảng viên`, `Lập chỉ mục`, `Lưu trữ`) enforced in place of forbidden K-12 terms? [Consistency, Spec §1.2, Spec §FR-012, FND §1.2]
- [ ] CHK022 Are language-mixing prohibitions (e.g. English button labels or placeholder copy on Vietnamese screens) explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §3.3, R01 §1 Rule 6]
- [ ] CHK023 Are upload validation failure messages (unsupported file type, oversized file, 0-byte file) documented with exact Vietnamese copy? [Clarity, Spec §6 User Story 2, Data-Model §3]
- [ ] CHK024 Are confirmation dialog texts for course removal (BLOCKED-ON-C1 — pending PO: C1-B soft archiving vs C1-A hard delete) and material deletion specified with explicit Vietnamese warnings explaining data preservation vs. removal? [Clarity, Spec §3.2, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-008]

## 5. Anti-AI-Slop & Design System Compliance (R01 §1 & §2)

- [ ] CHK025 Is the strict ban on Unicode emojis in JSX/TSX and UI chrome explicitly enforced with vector SVG icon requirements? [Clarity, Spec §3.3, R01 §1 Rule 1]
- [ ] CHK026 Are vector icon metaphors (Lucide icons `BookOpen`, `UploadCloud`, `CheckCircle2`, `AlertCircle`, `Trash2`, `X`) explicitly mapped to prevent raw ASCII text symbols as buttons? [Consistency, Spec §3.3, R01 §1 Rule 2]
- [ ] CHK027 Are brand and action colors strictly locked to Eduva Navy (`#2A4E7F`) and Sky (`#00A5F5`), with purple/indigo palettes and glowing borders prohibited? [Clarity, Spec §3.3, R01 §1 Rule 3]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the instructional callout limit (maximum 1 contextual alert banner per screen, no preachy guidance callouts) documented? [Clarity, Spec §3.3, R01 §1 Rule 4]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the 3-level surface ladder (`bg-page` white -> `bg-canvas` `#F3F6FC` -> `bg-surface` white card with no border/shadow -> max one inset `#EEF2F9`) defined across all views? [Consistency, Spec §3.3, R01 §1 Rule 5]
- [ ] CHK030 Are chatbot avatars, gamification badges, and typing animations prohibited from AI-assisted and RAG inspection components? [Clarity, Spec §3.3, R01 §1 Rule 7]
- [ ] CHK031 Are typography requirements constrained to Roboto regular (`Font-Weight: 400`) headings and 65–75 character reading measures for long-form text? [Measurability, Spec §3.3, R01 §4.1]

## 6. Edge Cases & Failure Recovery Scenarios

- [ ] CHK032 Are client-side file size validation boundary conditions specified (exact 50MB accepted vs. 50MB + 1 byte rejected before request)? [Edge Case, Spec §6 Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 Is error handling and user messaging specified for 0-byte empty files dropped into the upload area? [Edge Case, Spec §6 Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for network interruption during multipart upload (retaining file in queue, displaying reconnect retry)? [Recovery, Spec §6 Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Are requirements specified for handling ingestion timeouts when a material remains in `PROCESSING` status beyond 5 minutes? [Edge Case, Spec §6 Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements specified for course removal (BLOCKED-ON-C1 — pending PO: C1-B soft-archiving vs C1-A hard delete) when courses contain active materials and case studies (safeguarding child records without HTTP 500)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, PO Q4]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the behavior specified for attempting to delete a material while it is actively in `PROCESSING` status? [Edge Case, Spec §6 Edge Cases]

## 7. Measurability & Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK038 Can the "zero fake data" policy be objectively verified (complete removal of `MOCK_CHUNKS`, `OTHER_DOCUMENTS`, and hardcoded upload files)? [Measurability, Spec §8 SC-002, Jira AC 4]
- [ ] CHK039 Are visual fidelity criteria defined with verifiable browser inspection procedures at 1440px viewport against Figma Page 08 frames? [Measurability, Spec §8 SC-001, Spec §9]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the material table row-retention criterion measurable (table must not remove rows prior to receiving HTTP 200/204 confirmation from backend)? [Measurability, Spec §8 SC-004, PO Q5]
- [ ] CHK041 Is the production build validation criterion (`npm run build` passing with zero TypeScript or style errors) documented? [Measurability, Spec §8 SC-005, Jira AC 5]
